* '''Original''' ([[Libertine]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). While BB-8, DJ, or Rose aboard, immune to attrition &lt; 5.” '''What changed:''' re-rendered on release day with sharper graphics; same words.
